description.narrative: The Project will help increase living standards and reduce poverty in the project area by removing a transport constraint to sustainable economic growth, and improve safety and reliability by introducing new and modern technology. This will be achieved by providing efficient, affordable, environment-friendly, and energy-efficient railway transportation in unserved, less developed areas to create the conditions necessary for developing local resources and generating employment and income-enhancing opportunities.

description.narrative: An efficient, safe, reliable, affordable, and environment-friendly railway transport system in the region.
Fuel savings of CNY204 million are achieved by 2014 (Unit: CNY ten million). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Statistics from communication bureaus and MOR. Actual value:

Transport capacity is expanded in the corridor by 7 billion ton-km for freight by 2014 (Unit: billion ton-kms) Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: MOR statistics and operating data before and after the Project. Actual value:

Transport capacity is expanded in the corridor by 8 billion passenger-km for passengers by 2014 (Unit: billion passenger-km) Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Project administration missions and project completion report. Actual value:

Travel time is reduced from 32 hours to 18 hours, for travel from Shanghai to Chengdu (Unit: hour). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Post-evaluation surveys and reports from MOR. Actual value:
Cost of travel is reduced from 35 fen/km in 2007 to 15 fen/km by 2014 (Unit: CNY Fen/km) Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Statistics from communication bureaus and MOR. Actual value:

Travel time is reduced from 6 hours to 3 hours, for travel from Chongqing to Lichuan (Unit: hour). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Post-evaluation surveys and reports from MOR. Actual value:

All poverty villages along the alignment are provided with road access, drinking water, and telephone access by 2014. Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: Statistics from local governments. Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Railway infrastructure and associated facilities improved along the Chongqing-Lichuan railway corridor. Indicator: 259 km of railway line are constructed; equipment is procured and installed for train operations. Progress/Status: . As of end April 2014, the overall physical progress is estimated at 94% completed. The project has completed 100% of the bridge works, tunnel works and the overall civil works. Track laying for the main line has been completed by 99.3% and 73.8% for the station line and will be completed by the end of December 2014. The project started trial operation on 28 December 2013. The only ongoing major construction is new terminal of the Chongqing North Station which will be completed before 31 December 2014. The current trial operation utilizes the existing terminal of the Chongqing North Station. Data Source: PAM and PCR. Actual value:

Output: 1. Railway infrastructure and associated facilities improved along the Chongqing-Lichuan railway corridor. Indicator: 8 stations are constructed. Progress/Status: Not yet due. Data Source: PAM, progress reports, and PCR. Actual value:

Output: 2. Employment opportunities generated for poor and vulnerable groups to raise incomes and living standards, and reduce poverty. Indicator: Construction-related employment captures 50% of the jobs for unskilled labor. Data Source: Monitoring by the project company and external monitoring agency, PAM, progress reports, and PCR Actual value:

Output: 2. Employment opportunities generated for poor and vulnerable groups to raise incomes and living standards, and reduce poverty. Indicator: Project generates 119,000 person-years of construction-related employment. Progress/Status: A total of 33,480,662 person-days laborers have been recruited since commencement of CLR construction in 2009. Data Source: Monitoring by the project company and external monitoring agency, PAM, progress reports, and PCR. Actual value:
